verdict.rationale: Calendly's first-party routing docs describe routing forms that use answer-based logic to screen and qualify invitees before they book. They can also route from imported third-party form fields and match known leads to their Salesforce or HubSpot account owners, with conversion reporting on top. Round-robin and team scheduling are listed as features, but no doc explicitly ties routing to a team pool. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of routing answers to a team or round-robin pool rather than an individual, independent or hands-on corroboration of routing forms.
